title: Auto Refill & Medication Sync Program Schedule: Cycle Hold Thresholds
content:
The thresholds and switches that decide when an Auto Refill & Medication Sync cycle is held rather than filled are set per program as follows.

| Program | Rise in patient pay against the previous fill above which the cycle is held for the patient's approval | Cycle held when the coverage billed differs from the previous fill's | Calendar days an insurance rejection is retried before the cycle is held | Renewal request sent automatically when a cycle finds no refill remaining | Cycles in a row held without filling after which no further cycle is scheduled until the patient confirms continuation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | $10.00 | Yes | 3 | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | $20.00 | Yes | 3 | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | $10.00 | Yes | 3 | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | $20.00 | Yes | 3 | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | $10.00 | Yes | 3 | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | $20.00 | Yes | 5 | Yes | 2 |

## Units

- The price-change threshold is an amount in US dollars.
- The rejection retry period is a whole number of calendar days.
- The consecutive-held figure is a whole number of cycles.
- The insurance-change and renewal-request columns are yes-or-no switches.

## Pattern across the programs

- The price-change threshold follows the supply: $10.00 for the programs dispensing 30-day or 28-day cycles (Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day, Kestrel Med Sync Monthly, Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging) and $20.00 for the 90-day programs (Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day, Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day, Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill).
- Every program holds on an insurance change, sends a renewal request automatically, and stops at 2 held cycles in a row.
- The rejection retry period is 3 calendar days in every program except Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill, where it is 5.
